Agriculture | U.S. Representative Becca Balint Vermont farms are essential to our way of life and to our identity as Vermonters. Not only are they critical to our economy, but they are also central to climate resilience and food security. Becca is working to ensure that the 2023 Farm Bill supports local Vermont farms, not just industrial farms. Becca knows that Vermont farms, already on the frontlines of climate change, must be equipped with the resources they need to continue to produce nutrient-dense food and steward our land. Education | U.S. Representative Becca Balint Skip to Content Education Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Print this Page Share by Email As a former teacher, and a mother of two children, Becca knows the difference that a quality education can have on a person’s life. In Congress, Becca is working to make early childhood education affordable for all Vermont families. Becca believes that America’s public schools should be the best in the world, that’s why she is working to provide robust and equitable funding to K-12 public schools. Too many millions of Americans either cannot afford higher education or are burdened with significant student debt. This affordability crisis is stifling economic opportunities for a generation. Becca is focused on bringing down the cost of higher education and eliminating student debt. Related News Rep. Health Care | U.S. Representative Becca Balint Skip to Content Health Care Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Print this Page Share by Email Health care in the United States is the most expensive in the world. Millions of Americans cannot afford the life-saving medication they need, and too many Americans are crushed under the burden of medical debt. Becca believes that comprehensive health care should be accessible to everyone, not a privilege for those who can afford it. Families should not have to decide between receiving essential health care or putting food on the table.
